CheckTitle: Security Groups with SQL Server ports (1433, 1434) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to SQL Server ports.
Risk: Public Microsoft SQL Server ports (e.g., 1433) enable credential attacks and exploitation of vulnerabilities, leading to significant data exfiltration or encrypted ransom demands.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
